description: Upstream dependencies fetched by scripts/fetch_repos.sh into ./upstream/. Not vendored into git. xiaozhi-board-hal / xiaozhi-app are dolphinai626 forks of 78/xiaozhi-esp32 maintained on hal-only / app-only branches.

repos.name: xiaozhi-board-hal
repos.role: Board-level HAL component (codecs/display/camera/buttons). Mirror of 78/xiaozhi-esp32; we maintain a hal-only branch with business logic stripped.

repos.name: xiaozhi-app
repos.role: Xiaozhi business component (Application/protocols/mcp_server/wake_word). Forked from 78/xiaozhi-esp32; we maintain an app-only branch with board HAL stripped.

repos.name: volc_conv_ai
repos.role: Volcengine ConversationalAI Embedded Kit 2.0 (aios + conv_service + function_call_service). Pulled from Volcengine official; not forked.

repos.name: stackchan
repos.role: Original StackChan repo (reference only; we do not vendor or modify it).
